screen.rationale: Primary study; PS photo-oxidized over g-C3N4 with an unfiltered 300 W Xe lamp (and with a 400-800 nm filter in Table 1 entry 11). Molar masses only in figures and Table 1 gives only lumped carbon conversion/selectivity, but the text reports amounts of identified products (360 mg aromatic oxygenates, 240 mg isolated benzoic acid) from 500 mg PS pellets.

records.notes: Circulatory system: 8 h per cycle with solution drained and solvent replenished after each cycle; 20 cycles shown (Fig. 3 caption), steady rate for 18 cycles. Total irradiation time is not stated as a single value, so no time is recorded. 90% of pellets converted (no field). Split 74/15/11% of the 360 mg given without stated basis; not recorded as separate yields. [adjudicated yield_basis: located]
